title: The wedge γ∧β_0∧⋯∧β_{m−1} is linear in its first factor γ
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ and let β_0, …, β_{m−1} be continuous linear functionals on ℝ^P (β : Fin m → (ℝ^P)^*). Consider the map (ℝ^P)^* → Λ^{m+1}(ℝ^P)^* given by γ ↦ wedgeCovectors (m+1) (Fin.cons γ β) = γ∧β_0∧⋯∧β_{m−1}. This map is ℝ-linear (IsLinearMap ℝ): for all γ, δ ∈ (ℝ^P)^* and c ∈ ℝ, wedge(Fin.cons (γ+δ) β) = wedge(Fin.cons γ β) + wedge(Fin.cons δ β), and wedge(Fin.cons (c•γ) β) = c•wedge(Fin.cons γ β).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (β : Fin m → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)), IsLinearMap ℝ (fun γ : Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ => wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (Fin.cons γ β : Fin (m + 1) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)))
